comparisons.peer_topic: Defined benefit pension and postretirement benefit plan coverage
comparisons.peer_summary: The company sponsors non-contributory defined benefit pension plans for certain U.S. employees and various defined benefit pension and termination indemnity plans for employees outside the U.S., alongside postretirement health care and life insurance benefits for eligible retirees in the U.S. and internationally.
comparisons.comparison: Both BAC and C disclose that they sponsor postretirement health and life insurance plans for eligible employees transitioning to retirement status. BAC states that 'certain benefits-eligible employees may become eligible to continue participation as retirees in health care and/or life insurance plans,' while C similarly offers 'postretirement health care and life insurance benefits to certain eligible U.S. retired employees, as well as to certain eligible employees outside the U.S.' Both companies limit these benefits to specific eligible groups rather than all employees.

sentences.text: In addition to retirement pension benefits, certain benefits-eligible employees may become eligible to continue participation as retirees in health care and/or life insurance plans sponsored by the Corporation.
These plans are referred to as the Postretirement Health and Life Plans.
The Company also offers postretirement health care and life insurance benefits to certain eligible U.S. retired employees, as well as to certain eligible employees outside the U.S.

comparisons.peer_summary: The firm sponsors various pension plans and certain other postretirement benefit plans, primarily healthcare and life insurance, and provides certain benefits to former or inactive employees prior to retirement.
comparisons.comparison: Both BAC and GS disclose the sponsorship of postretirement healthcare and life insurance plans. BAC describes these as 'Postretirement Health and Life Plans' for 'certain benefits-eligible employees,' whereas GS states the firm sponsors 'certain other postretirement benefit plans, primarily healthcare and life insurance.' Both disclosures identify healthcare and life insurance as the core components of these postretirement benefits.

sentences.text: In addition to retirement pension benefits, certain benefits-eligible employees may become eligible to continue participation as retirees in health care and/or life insurance plans sponsored by the Corporation.
The firm sponsors various pension plans and certain other postretirement benefit plans, primarily healthcare and life insurance.

comparisons.peer_summary: The firm maintains unfunded postretirement benefit plans providing medical and life insurance for eligible retirees and their dependents, which do not have a material impact on the firm's consolidated results of operations.
comparisons.comparison: Both BAC and GS provide medical and life insurance to eligible retirees through postretirement plans. BAC notes that employees may 'continue participation as retirees in health care and/or life insurance plans,' while GS explicitly mentions 'unfunded postretirement benefit plans that provide medical and life insurance for eligible retirees and their dependents.' This comparison highlights the shared benefit type (medical/life) and beneficiary group (eligible retirees).
